description: This class includes the manufacture of batteries and accumulators.
includes: manufacture of primary cells and primary batteries: cells containing manganese dioxide, mercuric oxide, silver oxide, lithium, iodine, etc.
manufacture of electric accumulators: lead-acid, nickel-cadmium, nickel-metal hydride, lithium-ion, lithium polymer batteries
manufacture of separators for batteries and accumulators
excludes: manufacture of carbon and graphite electrodes, see 2399
